tips.text: Run the Void Storms solo or with a coordinated duo; public squads leave breaches unfixed.
For mastery alone any roll works; Valence Fusion can raise the bonus later.
Bank keys before a good roll shows up; the offer lasts only a few days.
Do not wait for a perfect roll: buy a decent percentage, forma it to rank 40 and add an Elemental Vice.
Players call the Holokey farm one of the worst grinds because it sits behind Railjack, though recent reports say it is not bad.
